Vs.
Mosammat Sharifun Nessa and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain J: This appeal by leave is directed against the judgment and order dated 10-8-2006 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Writ Petition No. 6786 of 2005 directing the writ-respondents to release the land measuring 0.29 acre at Mouza- Dhanmondi under Dhanmondi Police Station appertaining to CS Plot NO.192 and SA Plot No.868 tinder CS Khatian No.189 and SA Khatian No.2/ A, acquired in LA Case No.122/60-61. 

 "The land of CS Khatian No.189, SA Khatian No. 2/A was acquired and requiring authority took possession of the said acquired land and the gazette notification was published on 4-1-1973, so the petitioner cannot get any relief as prayed for, that for some time mere non use of the acquired land for the purpose for which it was acquired will not give any right to get return of the same as once a property is validly acquired after completing the legal formalities it vests in the government and its previous owner does not have any right to ask return of the same for its non-utilization for some time for the specific purpose for which it was acquired and hence the writ petition was not, maintainable and the grounds taken in the writ petition had no merit and, as such, the Rule was liable to be discharged with costs."
